summary: Defines the entire schema-versioned architecture operation-plan domain for `beep architecture`: literal-kit domains and S.Class operation/plan/result models, the ~700-line static accepted-proof file manifest, role/stage selection logic, package-shell scaffold content generators, a concept/context template-retargeting rewrite engine, and the three effectful plan factories plus JSON codecs. It is consumed by Architecture.command.ts, OperationPlanExecution.ts, OperationPlanPackageJson.ts, and the 699-line test via the `@beep/repo-cli/commands/Architecture` facade.

concerns.name: Literal domains + operation/plan schema classes
concerns.description: Ten LiteralKit literal domains and eleven S.Class models forming the schema-versioned plan contract (lines ~21-835), including the union ArchitectureOperation and the CanonicalSliceOperationPlan with its legacy `slice` getter.

concerns.name: Schema-default field wrappers
concerns.description: Private constant-default wrappers pairing S.withConstructorDefault + S.withDecodingDefault so legacy serialized plans decode (lines 375-406).

concerns.name: Accepted-proof manifest (static data)
concerns.description: The internal AcceptedProofFile class, rolePackageFiles generator, the huge ordered acceptedProofFiles literal catalog of every canonical architecture-lab proof path with role/stage/writer, and legacyFixturePaths (lines ~805-816, 888-1661). Pure data, zero behavior.

concerns.name: Role/stage topology pure domain logic
concerns.description: Stage ordering/inclusion, role sets per domain-kind, db-admin gating, package name/path/exports derivation per role, and target normalization (lines 838-886, 1722-1764, 2340-2343).

concerns.name: Operation metadata normalization
concerns.description: Derives operationId, writeMode, and conflictPolicy from operation kind and re-makes each union member with source metadata (lines 1663-1720). Uses conditional chains where the schemas' own defaults or a match helper could dispatch.

concerns.name: Package-shell scaffold content generation
concerns.description: Inline string templates for AGENTS.md/README/docgen.json/tsconfig/vitest/index.ts/layers/tables, per-role dependency and export catalogs, and assembly into WriteFileOperation/WritePackageJsonOperation lists (lines 1766-2338).

concerns.name: Template retargeting rewrite engine
concerns.description: Infers source concept/domain-kind from proof paths and rewrites paths and file contents across Pascal/camel/kebab/snake case families to retarget architecture-lab templates at a new bounded context and concept (lines 2345-2492).

concerns.name: Effectful plan factories + JSON codecs
concerns.description: The three exported plan constructors (makeArchitectureOperationPlan reads files via FileSystem/Path and preserves existing package-level files), file selection, role validation, and fromJsonString encode/decode codecs (lines 2494-2764).

proposedSplit.contents: All ten LiteralKit domains, the constant-default field wrappers, the eleven S.Class models (including CanonicalSliceOperationPlan with its slice getter, check/apply result classes), the ArchitectureOperation union, defaultArchitecturePlanTarget, and the encode/decodeCanonicalSliceOperationPlanJson codecs. Zero Effect service dependencies, so OperationPlanExecution.ts and OperationPlanPackageJson.ts can retarget their imports here without cycles.

The exported factories makeCanonicalSliceOperationPlan, makeArchitectureOperationPlan, makeArchitecturePackageOperationPlan plus their private wiring: normalizeInput, selectFiles, rolePlansForFiles, validateRequestedRoles, and the operation-metadata normalizers (operationIdFor, writeModeForKind, conflictPolicyForKind, withOperationMetadata).

The internal AcceptedProofFile schema class, roleBasePath, rolePackageFiles, the full ordered acceptedProofFiles catalog, and legacyFixturePaths. Order must be preserved verbatim; this mirrors the established internal/ convention used by Yeet and VersionSync.

Pure role/stage domain logic: stageOrder/stageRank/isStageIncluded, aggregateRoles/entityRoles/valueRoles, rolesForDomainKind, roleAllowedForDomainKind, dbAdminProofTargetAllowed, roleAllowedForTarget, packageNameForRole, pathForRole, exportsForRole, rolePlanFor, isDefaultPlanTarget.

All packageShell* content generators and catalogs (agents/readme/docgen/tsconfig/vitest/index/layer/test-layer/tables content, exports/description/dependency/devDependency per-role maps, categoryForRole, extraExportForRole), packageShellTargetFor, packageShellRolePlanFor, shellPackageJsonOperationFor, and packageShellFileOperationsFor.

The concept/context rewrite engine: sourceConceptForPath, sourceDomainKindForPath, sourceConceptPathFor, isPackageScaffoldFile, isPackageIndexFile, isPackageLevelFile, proofFileMatchesDomainKind, targetPathFor, replacementPairs, renderAcceptedTemplate.

Update the facade to re-export Architecture.schemas.ts and Architecture.plan.ts (replacing the `./OperationPlan.js` star export) so every currently-public symbol keeps resolving via @beep/repo-cli/commands/Architecture; internal/ stays private. Delete OperationPlan.ts once OperationPlanExecution.ts and OperationPlanPackageJson.ts point at Architecture.schemas.ts.

sharedCandidates.description: The repeated S.withConstructorDefault + S.withDecodingDefault pair around a constant (8 occurrences here) is a one-liner `SchemaUtils.withConstantDefault(schema, value)` candidate for @beep/schema next to withEmptyArrayDefaults.
Rewriting an identifier across Pascal/camel/kebab/snake/UPPER_SNAKE families via ordered Str.replaceAll pairs is a generic scaffold-retargeting utility, independent of architecture plans.

Canonical package scaffold knowledge (tsconfig shape, vitest merge config, docgen.json, workspace/catalog dependency conventions) duplicates what CreatePackage/templates/*.hbs and TemplateService encode; a shared scaffold-content module would keep the two generators from drifting.
Duplicated verbatim in OperationPlanExecution.ts:27-28; not cross-group, but the split should export it once (from Architecture.plan.ts or schemas) and delete the copy.

risks: index.ts does `export * from "./OperationPlan.js"`, making every export public via @beep/repo-cli/commands/Architecture; test/architecture-operation-plan.test.ts (699 lines) imports 12 of them through that alias, so the rewired facade must preserve every current export name or the test and any external consumers break.

The $I identity is `$RepoCliId.create("commands/Architecture/OperationPlan")` and is baked into every schema identifier/annotation; splitting files while keeping deterministic schema identities matters for the generated schema catalog (PR #318) — either keep the same $I.create string in the new schemas file or accept catalog churn.

OperationPlanExecution.ts and OperationPlanPackageJson.ts import values and types from ./OperationPlan.js; retarget them to Architecture.schemas.ts only (never Architecture.plan.ts) to avoid import cycles, since Architecture.plan.ts depends on internal/ modules that reference the schemas.

Legacy decode compatibility: the "legacy-operation"/"legacy-plan" decoding defaults and the CanonicalSliceOperationPlan.slice getter exist so previously serialized plan JSON still decodes; the default-wrapped field schemas must move together with the operation classes unchanged.
acceptedProofFiles array order determines generated operation order; tests assert plan determinism/idempotency, so the manifest extraction must be byte-order-faithful.

Nearly every exported symbol carries executable JSDoc @example blocks importing from "@beep/repo-cli/commands/Architecture" or ".../Architecture/index" — docgen (bun run docgen:local) will re-compile them, so facade re-exports must be in place before the docgen proof; no dtslint file targets this group today (only Files.tst.ts exists).
